description: Find the docs page to cite before answering any question about a WebExtension API, a manifest key, a permission, or a difference between Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari. It searches the Extension.js and extension.dev docs (free, no login) and answers with the pages, each with its URL and an excerpt. Memory is the fallback only when it returns nothing.

api.description: Platform base URL (default EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else https://www.extension.dev)

limit.description: How many pages to return, 1 to 8.

query.description: What to look up, in a few words.

name: extension_docs_search
